description: Closed split mold with keyed printed core and stock 5 mm hex mandrel, fill funnel and three vents. Nominal zero shrink compensation until silicone formulation is measured.
engineering_blockers: 25A hardness does not specify silicone chemistry, cure inhibition, shrinkage or permissible rotating speed.
Mask and release the stock hex mandrel and seal the split line before pouring; geometric clearances do not establish leak tightness.
Use measured cure/shrinkage coupons, inspect voids, verify core/tire retention and dynamically balance before powered use.
Mold, cast rotor, printed core, fit and fasteners need physical validation.
name: BIOBUZZ 100 mm cast-in 25A silicone flywheel mold

mold_cavity_diameter_mm.description: Nominal cavity diameter; accepted production drawing is100 mm. Other sizes require a separately approved shrink-compensation contract.
